D3DCompiler on Windows

The Windows x64 Installer and Portable use the system copy of d3dcompiler_47.dll provided in Windows System32. The package contains no copy of this DLL. No separate SDK or installer is required on a supported, up-to-date Windows 10 or Windows 11 installation.

Microsoft Windows API reference:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/win32-and-com/win32-apis
